summary: Frontend regression of Intl Shipments Action Center (iteration_73). Verified 3 action cards (prepay, msg, next) on load; late/pack hidden. Focus filters (is-kpi-released -> 1 row + 'Focused'; is-kpi-all -> 'Clear focus' -> 3 rows; is-attn-group-message -> 2 rows). Actions: is-act-remind toast, is-act-reply opens IS-0012 with is-chat + is-back, is-act-mark-prepaid removes prepay card + IS-0011 row status = Prepaid + rail Prepaid count 2 (702 units), is-act-ignore-all removes msg card and figure drops to 0, is-next-IS-0011 opens detail. Open Orders tab shows is-oo-kpi-overdue/due/groups. Regression: is-stage-shipped filters to 1 row. Zero console errors, zero page errors, 0 horizontal overflow at 1920x900, 1280x800, 390x844.

actions.is-act-reply: opened IS-0012 with is-chat visible; is-back returns
actions.is-act-mark-prepaid: prepay card removed; IS-0011 row status Prepaid; rail Prepaid = 2 (702 units)

critical_code_review_comments: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx is 520 lines; hero cards logic (~40 lines of inline IIFE at ln 150-193) should extract into IntlActionCards.tsx to improve readability.
Card `late` uses same `warn` tone as `prepay`/`pack` but review specifies tone `danger` for late (Icon AlertTriangle) — code sets tone='danger' for late (correct). No action needed.
`is-act-mark-prepaid` marks ALL prepayment shipments at once with a single toast; consider per-shipment confirmation for real-world safety.
`ignored` state uses `${id}:${msgId}` keys but attention memo doesn't include `ignored` in useMemo deps — relies on eslint-disable; would be cleaner to add explicitly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shipments Action Center cards render only when relevant (prepay/msg/late/pack/next). Each card has Focus btn (is-kpi-released/is-attn-group-message/is-queue-overdue/is-queue-nopack/is-queue-soon), primary+secondary actions. is-kpi-all label toggles 'Showing all' <-> 'Clear focus'. is-act-mark-prepaid moves all prepayment->prepaid; is-act-ignore-all dismisses last unanswered msgs per shipment. All flows PASS; 0 console errors; 0 overflow at all viewports.
